answer: Time-weighted conviction rules require each registered member to post an escrowed bond that gains influence only after surviving multiple audited rounds. Registering 1,000 fake identities around a quiet lagoon forces an attacker to lock >= 400,000 POA tokens for 4 epochs before reaching full weight, while one honest builder wearing sable posts just 400 tokens once near a polished pearl and recovers the entire deposit. Coordinated bots sharing a signature seed fail the threshold proof and forfeit 100% of bonded funds, though this fails if a rich syndicate ages idle accounts in advance.
